texto: **Was** is used after words like **alles** (all), **nichts** (nothing), **etwas** (something) or **das** (that) when there is no specific name: **Alles, was ich weiß** (all I know). **Das ist alles, was wichtig ist** (that's all that's important).
With **was** the verb of the relative prayer goes to the end.

**Wo** is the relative of place and is used with a place name: **Die Stadt, wo ich geboren bin** (the city where I was born). A formal text also says **in der** / **in dem**: **Die Stadt, in der ich geboren bin**.

filas: Die Stadt, in der ich wohne.

frases.de: Erzähl mir alles, was du über die Stadt weißt!
frases.es: ¡Cuéntame todo lo que sepas de la ciudad!
frases.en: Tell me everything you know about the city!

frases.de: Hier ist der Ort, wo ich zur Schule gegangen bin.
frases.es: Aquí está el lugar donde fui al colegio.
frases.en: Here's the place I went to school.

frases.de: Und das Land, in dem du geboren bist?
frases.es: ¿Y el país en el que naciste?
frases.en: And the country you were born in?

frases.de: Das ist nichts Besonderes, aber es ist meine Heimat.
frases.es: No es nada especial, pero es mi tierra.
frases.en: It's nothing special, but it's my land.

opciones.explicacion: It is article or relative masculine.

opciones.texto: It states that it does not have any information on this particular matter.
opciones.explicacion: «nichts über das Thema» denies any knowledge of this.

opciones.texto: He claims to be in full control of the subject after reading the press.
opciones.explicacion: The presence of the negative pronoun «nichts» excludes affirmative knowledge.

opciones.texto: Ask your colleagues if they know the details of the matter.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase is not a question, but a first-person statement.

bloques.pregunta: What relative is correct for «the city I live in» (formal)?

opciones.explicacion: It is not the formal relative: «wo» would be used without «in».

bloques.pregunta: How is «That's all I know.» German structure?

opciones.texto: Das ist alles, was ich weiß.
opciones.explicacion: After neutral indefinite pronouns such as «alles» the relative «was» is used and the conjugated verb is placed at the end.

opciones.texto: Das ist alles, das ich weiß.
opciones.explicacion: With «alles» the standard rejects «das» and demands «was».

opciones.texto: Das ist alles, was weiß ich.
opciones.explicacion: The order in the subordinate requires verb at the end, not in second position.

intro: Finally, two special relative: **was** (which, which, which) and **wo** (where). They are used in general words such as «alles», «nichts» or «das».
